396.DSCR: A member of the anti-$$ＮＥＲＶ$$ organization '$$ＷＩＬＬＥ$$,' she serves as the pilot of $$エヴァンゲリオン改２号機$$ and is apparently fighting $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ together with $$ミサト$$ and $$マリ$$.
396.DSC2:
A member of the anti-$$ＮＥＲＶ$$ organization '$$ＷＩＬＬＥ$$,' she serves as the pilot of $$エヴァンゲリオン改２号機$$ and is apparently fighting $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ together with $$ミサト$$ and $$マリ$$.
She treats $$シンジ$$ harshly, calling him 'Brat $$シンジ$$' as he is left bewildered, with the situation never explained to him. She wears an eyepatch over her left eye, but what happened to it is unknown.

397.DSCR:
An EVA pilot.
Born in England, she belongs to the Euro Branch of the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
Known for her red-framed glasses and a speech habit of sometimes tacking 'nya' onto the ends of sentences. She has an optimistic personality, but $$加持$$ calls her a 'problem child.' At the $$ベタニアベース$$, she piloted the $$ＥＶＡ仮設５号機$$ and fought the Third Angel.
She later visits $$第３新東京市$$, where she sniffs out the faint scent of L.C.L. clinging to $$シンジ$$ and nicknames him '$$ＮＥＲＶ$$'s little puppy.' Her words and actions are eccentric, and much about her remains a mystery.

proofread.reason: omission: tokidoki (sometimes) was missing; tense: 'rode ... and fought' is a completed past event (the next sentence says she LATER visits Tokyo-3); 'to fight' also turned a sequence into a purpose

398.DSCR:
$$マリ$$, fourteen years after the '$$ニアサードインパクト$$.'
A member of the anti-$$ＮＥＲＶ$$ organization '$$ＷＩＬＬＥ$$,' she pilots $$エヴァンゲリオン８号機$$ and fights $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ together with $$アスカ$$.
Unlike $$アスカ$$, who wears an eyepatch, the only change in her appearance is the shape of her glasses. Her personality has not changed either, and she remains as cheerful and true to her own pace as ever.

399.DSCR:
A mysterious boy at the lunar $$タブハベース$$.
He speaks and acts as though he knows $$シンジ$$.

proofread.reason: addition/mistranslation: 'is at' not 'stationed'; the Japanese says he behaves AS IF he knew Shinji, not 'suggest he somehow already knows'

400.DSCR:
A boy who belongs to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
He loves playing the piano, invites the lonely $$シンジ$$ to play piano duets, and deepens their friendship.
He removes the $$ＤＳＳチョーカー$$ from $$シンジ$$, who has shut his heart after learning that the world has been devastated, and fastens it around his own neck.
400.DSC2:
A boy who belongs to $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
He loves playing the piano, invites the lonely $$シンジ$$ to play piano duets, and deepens their friendship.
He removes the $$ＤＳＳチョーカー$$ from $$シンジ$$, who has shut his heart after learning that the world has been devastated, and fastens it around his own neck.
He boards $$エヴァンゲリオン第１３号機$$ together with $$シンジ$$ and attempts to carry out the 'repair of the world.' But before he can achieve his goal, the choker activates, and he dies before $$シンジ$$'s eyes.

401.DSCR:
Chief of Section 1, Operations Division, Tactical Operations Department at the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$. Rank: Lieutenant Colonel at first, later promoted to Colonel. Age 29.
She is the field commander in the battles against the Angels, taking command of operations in place of $$ゲンドウ$$ or $$冬月$$ when they are absent. She burns with a fierce determination to destroy the Angels, though the details remain unclear.
On duty, her strong sense of responsibility makes her strict with herself and others, and she is bold enough to carry out operations that sometimes seem reckless. She is basically cheerful and caring by nature, but she is slovenly in her private life and hardly ever cooks or cleans.
She acts as a guardian figure to $$シンジ$$, letting him live in her apartment, where she lives with the hot-spring penguin $$ペンペン$$, and watching over his growth as someone who understands him, sometimes strict and sometimes gentle. $$アスカ$$ later joins this household as well.
She has known $$リツコ$$ and $$加持$$ since their school days, and was once $$加持$$'s lover.

proofread.reason: addition; mistranslation: addition: Japanese says only that she lives with the hot-spring penguin Pen Pen (温泉ペンギンのペンペンと住む自分のマンション), not that it is her pet; mistranslation: 詳しい事は不明 is 'the details are unknown', not 'the reasons'

403.DSCR:
Supreme Commander of the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
While leading $$ＮＥＲＶ$$ in the fight against the Angels, he secretly advances the $$人類補完計画$$ on $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$'s orders.
He is $$シンジ$$'s father, but his uncompromising manner toward his son means their relationship is far from good.
Always cold and severe, he never reveals his true intentions. The one exception is his relationship with $$レイ#pt394$$, with whom he converses and smiles, and for whom he shows open emotion, even rushing to help her when she is endangered during an experiment.
When he visited the grave of his late wife, $$ユイ$$, he had $$シンジ$$ come along as well.
As the fighting continues, he gradually begins to offer words of approval to $$シンジ$$, and $$シンジ$$ is pleased by them. $$レイ#pt394$$, hoping to bring father and son closer together, plans a meal for the two of them, but the incident in which Unit-03 is infiltrated by an Angel becomes the catalyst for their relationship deteriorating beyond repair.

proofread.reason: pronoun/referent: referent: シンジもそれを喜ぶ - it is Shinji who is glad; 'which pleases him' after 'he' = Gendo (both male) reads as Gendo

408.DSCR:
Chief Inspector of the special agency $$ＮＥＲＶ$$.
He comes to $$第３新東京市$$ from the Euro Branch, assigned to Headquarters. He acts on special orders and is well-connected to all manner of underground information.
Easygoing and hard to pin down, he also has an unpretentious side, such as working in the fields alongside $$シンジ$$.
He has known $$ミサト$$ and $$リツコ$$ since their school days, and was once $$ミサト$$'s lover.

410.DSCR:
A student in Year 2 Class A at $$第３新東京市$$ Municipal Junior High School No. 1.
A dedicated military otaku whose hobby is photographing weapons, he envies $$シンジ$$ and the other EVA pilots.
As $$トウジ$$ puts it, he is 'a guy who's honest about his own desires'; during an evacuation order issued in response to an Angel attack, he talks $$トウジ$$ into sneaking out of the shelter with him so he can watch the battle with his own eyes. $$シンジ$$ saves him during that battle, and $$ケンスケ$$ becomes his friend alongside $$トウジ$$.

416.DSCR:
A military officer of the $$中華連邦$$ who combines outstanding combat ability with political skill. Age 24.
His name is properly pronounced in Chinese as '$$黎星刻$$.'
Deeply loyal, he swore a pact of Eternal Harmony with $$天子$$ after she once saved his life. However, his body is being consumed by a serious illness.
He served as an escort to $$高亥$$, the $$中華連邦$$'s Consul-General to $$エリア１１$$, but purged $$高亥$$ after $$ギアス$$ caused him to place $$ゼロ$$ above the nation's interests.
Upon returning to the $$中華連邦$$ once a new Consul-General was chosen, he plotted a coup against the Grand Eunuch who ruled the Federation, for the sake of the $$天子$$ he revered. Having once had his life saved by the young $$天子$$, $$星刻$$ could not accept the Grand Eunuch's methods of using her as a tool for his ambitions while indulging in nothing but his own self-interest.
He launched the coup to prevent $$天子$$'s political marriage, but she was ultimately taken into $$ゼロ$$'s custody. He briefly submitted to the Grand Eunuch in order to reclaim $$天子$$ and rescue his captured subordinates, but upon learning the Grand Eunuch intended to sacrifice her as a pawn, he struck the Grand Eunuch down with $$ゼロ$$'s help.
From then on, he allied with the $$黒の騎士団$$, and served as commander-in-chief of the $$黒の騎士団$$ within the $$超合集国$$ military.
In the final battle, he exploited a brief opening to storm the $$アヴァロン$$ and successfully freed $$天子$$ and the others who had been held hostage by $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$.

419.DSCR:
Former chief of the $$特別派遣嚮導技術部$$. Age 30.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, he became chief of $$キャメロット$$, the development agency directly under the $$ナイトオブセブン$$.
A genius engineer who developed the $$ランスロット$$, but so absorbed in technical development that he was out of touch with the world, and there were aspects of him that lacked humanity, such as calling $$スザク$$ a 'part.'
He had been rivals with $$ラクシャータ$$ since their days in a university laboratory, and even now, after a long time, the two still burned with a competitive spirit toward each other.
Once $$ルルーシュ$$ became Emperor of $$ブリタニア$$ and $$スザク$$ became the $$ナイトオブゼロ$$, he learned of their plan and cooperated with it. At the final battle he worked with $$ニーナ$$, lending a hand in the development of the $$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$.
He also came from an earl's family and was engaged to $$ミレイ$$, but the engagement was broken off by $$ミレイ$$'s side. He himself, however, never minded in the least.

420.DSCR:
Former member of the $$特別派遣嚮導技術部$$. Age 25.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, she was transferred to $$キャメロット$$ and assigned exclusively to $$スザク$$.
As $$ロイド$$'s subordinate, she took part in the development of the $$ランスロット$$, and was also the chief developer of the $$フロートシステム$$. She also had the role of reining in the outrageously inconsiderate $$ロイド$$, and often resorted to force.
She had a caring personality and a peculiar sense for cooking, and would make dishes of strange combinations and serve them to those around her.
Later she learned of $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$スザク$$'s plan, $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$, and cooperated with it. At the final battle she served as an operator aboard the $$アヴァロン$$.

424.DSCR:
A member since the founding of the $$黒の騎士団$$, and a former member of the resistance organization '$$扇$$ Group.' Age 25.
He was optimistic by nature and thoroughly a joker. And yet he complained about one thing after another, and would snap at once at anything that displeased him.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$ he was held by $$ブリタニア$$ for a little over a year, but was rescued by $$ゼロ$$ just before his execution and returned to the $$黒の騎士団$$.
In the $$超合集国$$ military he served as 'Internal Affairs Cleanup Assistant Officer,' but the content of that post is unknown.
He called himself $$ゼロ$$'s best friend and trusted $$ゼロ$$, so when the $$黒の騎士団$$ and $$ゼロ$$ parted ways, he grieved in earnest.
After all the fighting was over, he did not join the new Japanese government, and became the owner of a coffee shop.

427.DSCR:
A classmate of $$ルルーシュ$$ and one of the members of the $$アッシュフォード学園$$ Student Council. Age 18.
Besides the Student Council, she also belonged to the swim club. She was honest and cheerful by nature, the type whose joys and sorrows showed plainly on her face.
She once lost her memories of $$ルルーシュ$$ to $$ギアス$$, but $$シャルル$$'s memory-rewriting $$ギアス$$ reworked her memories again and returned her to the state she was in before she learned $$ゼロ$$'s identity.
She called $$ルルーシュ$$ 'Lulu' and secretly had feelings for him. With her memories rewritten, she was able to live school life as before, and her relationship with $$ルルーシュ$$ progressed after many twists and turns.
However, $$ジェレミア$$'s $$ギアスキャンセラー$$ erased the effect of the $$ギアス$$, and the memories that had been sealed came back, plunging her into suspicion and doubt. Even so, her feelings for $$ルルーシュ$$ never faded, and she resolved to become his strength, but along the way she ran into $$ロロ$$. She was shot by $$ロロ$$, who feared that $$シャーリー$$'s existence would destroy the relationship between himself and $$ルルーシュ$$.
To $$ルルーシュ$$, who rushed to her side, she said that no matter how much her memories were changed, her feelings had never changed, and, telling him 'I'd fall in love with you again no matter how many times I was reborn,' she breathed her last.

428.DSCR:
President of the $$アッシュフォード学園$$ Student Council. Age 19.
She would think up outlandish events and carry them out using her authority as Student Council President. She did nothing but throw those around her into turmoil, but perhaps because of her caring nature, she was well loved.
By rights she should have graduated, but she fell just short on credits and repeated a year, and so continued as Student Council President.
Later, prompted by the words of $$ニーナ$$, whom she met again, she resolved to end her moratorium. She also dissolved her engagement to $$ロイド$$, and switched careers to become an announcer so that she could live by her own power.

429.DSCR:
One of the members of the $$アッシュフォード学園$$ Student Council. Age 18.
An optimist who figured that as long as he could enjoy himself every day, that was enough, and a partner in mischief to $$ルルーシュ$$.
He had feelings for Student Council President $$ミレイ$$, but was always brushed off by her.
As his former companions were swallowed up by the turmoil of the world, he was left alone amid his rapidly changing surroundings, but his nature as someone who cared about his friends never changed.

430.DSCR:
Former member of the $$アッシュフォード学園$$ Student Council. Age 18.
After losing $$ユーフェミア$$, whom she adored, she independently developed a new type of bomb in order to strike down $$ゼロ$$, $$ユーフェミア$$'s killer. She used it in the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, but it misfired that time.
Afterward she joined the research team '$$インヴォーグ$$,' under the jurisdiction of $$シュナイゼル$$, and as its chief took charge of developing the tactical weapon $$フレイヤ$$.
Having devoted everything to striking down $$ゼロ$$, $$ユーフェミア$$'s killer, $$ニーナ$$ entrusted $$フレイヤ$$ to $$スザク$$ during the $$第二次トウキョウ決戦$$, and $$スザク$$ ended up pulling the trigger through a force not of his own intent. But upon witnessing its power with her own eyes, $$ニーナ$$ realized the gravity of what she had done.
Afterward, to find an answer to her doubts, she developed the $$フレイヤ・エリミネーター$$, which neutralizes $$フレイヤ$$, under $$ルルーシュ$$, who had become Emperor. She entrusted it to $$ルルーシュ$$, $$ユーフェミア$$'s killer.

431.DSCR:
$$ルルーシュ$$'s false younger brother.
He possessed a $$ギアス$$ that stopped the perceived time of others, but it carried a major weakness: his own heart stopped while it was in use.
In truth he was a cold-blooded assassin dispatched by the $$ギアス嚮団$$, and kept $$ルルーシュ$$ under surveillance as a member of the $$機密情報局$$.
Although he learned that $$ルルーシュ$$ had regained his memories of $$ゼロ$$, $$ルルーシュ$$, who had obtained information about his origins and upbringing in advance, struck at his psychological weakness and won him over.
He initially harbored strong doubts about $$ルルーシュ$$, who promised to 'give him a future,' but the doubt gradually changed into trust. With nothing else to cling to, $$ロロ$$ came to place blind trust in $$ルルーシュ$$, the only one he could rely on.
That twisted devotion drove him to turn his blade against his former master, $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$, and swelled until he pulled the trigger on $$シャーリー$$, who had known $$ルルーシュ$$'s identity and still tried to help him. In time he even plotted to kill $$ルルーシュ$$'s real sister, $$ナナリー$$, but just then $$ナナリー$$ was swallowed by the blast of $$フレイヤ$$ and went missing.
$$ルルーシュ$$, who lay in the depths of despair from losing $$ナナリー$$, completely denied the existence of $$ロロ$$, whom he had been using all along, yet $$ロロ$$'s trust in $$ルルーシュ$$ never wavered.
He rushed to $$ルルーシュ$$'s aid when the $$黒の騎士団$$ had him cornered, and saved him by using the time-stopping $$ギアス$$ continuously in exchange for his own life.
In the end, he was acknowledged by $$ルルーシュ$$ as his brother, and breathed his last there.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: mistranslation: 監視している is surveillance/monitoring, 'watched over' means protecting

432.DSCR:
The 98th Emperor of the $$神聖ブリタニア帝国$$. Age 63.
The real father of $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$ナナリー$$.
He believed that inequality breeds competition and that competition drives evolution. He also worshiped power above all, upheld the doctrine that peace is evil, and had a cold-hearted way of thinking that would mercilessly cast aside even his own children if they were weak.
He possessed a $$ギアス$$ that rewrites the memories of others, and used it to take the memories of $$ルルーシュ$$, who had been captured by $$スザク$$ in the $$ブラックリベリオン$$.
He had once sworn with his twin brother, $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$, to create a 'world without lies,' and sought to unite the consciousness of all humanity with the $$集合無意識$$. However, he became disillusioned with his brother, who spoke of creating a world without lies yet lied to himself. He took the Code from his brother and made himself immortal.
During the $$第二次トウキョウ決戦$$, he succeeded in luring $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$, the other Code holder needed for the $$ラグナレクの接続$$, into the $$思考エレベーター$$ on $$神根島$$, but his plan was thwarted by $$ルルーシュ$$. In the end, all of it was denied by $$ルルーシュ$$, and he vanished together with $$マリアンヌ$$, who had endorsed the plan.

433.DSCR:
The real mother of $$ルルーシュ$$ and $$ナナリー$$, and a former empress consort of the Empire of $$ブリタニア$$.
Of commoner origin, she served as a KMF test pilot before marrying $$シャルル$$. Her superb ability earned her the name '$$マリアンヌ$$ the Flash,' and she had many followers.
Eight years earlier, she was assassinated at the hands of $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$. This was because $$マリアンヌ$$ had endorsed $$シャルル$$'s plan and become his comrade, but $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$ felt impatience at how $$シャルル$$ and she were changing through coming to understand each other. At the moment of her death, however, $$マリアンヌ$$ awakened a $$ギアス$$ that lets her cross into the minds of others, and came to lurk within $$アーニャ$$, who was then at the estate as an etiquette apprentice.
When she learned that $$シャルル$$'s plan had entered its final stage, she took control of $$アーニャ$$'s consciousness and persuaded $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$, who had temporarily sealed away her Code, to go with her to $$神根島$$. There she was reunited with $$ルルーシュ$$, but $$ルルーシュ$$ and her former comrade $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$ denied her plan with $$シャルル$$, and she was annihilated.

434.DSCR:
Second Prince of the $$神聖ブリタニア帝国$$, who also served as Prime Minister. Age 28.
He had a gentle manner and an evenhandedness that made no distinction between people, and gathered tremendous popularity among those around him. His mind also surpassed even that of $$ルルーシュ$$, and he was the only person $$ルルーシュ$$ could never beat at chess.
Yet behind that selfless spirit lay a nihilistic nature that clung to nothing.
He had long grown distrustful of $$シャルル$$, who had no interest in politics, and plotted a coup to make himself emperor. After $$シャルル$$ went missing and $$ルルーシュ$$ ascended to the throne as emperor, he set up $$ナナリー$$ as the true emperor and challenged $$ルルーシュ$$.
$$シュナイゼル$$'s true aim was to seize the world through the terror of $$フレイヤ$$ and become a 'god' who would educate humanity. However, once that nature was seen through, $$シュナイゼル$$ was defeated by $$ルルーシュ$$. Placed under the $$ギアス$$ 'Serve $$ゼロ$$,' he came to devote the rest of his life to $$ゼロ$$.

435.DSCR:
Second Princess of the $$神聖ブリタニア帝国$$. Age 28.
She once served as Viceroy of $$エリア１１$$, but gave up the post after the $$ブラックリベリオン$$. Since then she had dropped out of sight, and conducted her own investigation to clear the tarnished name of her full-blooded younger sister, $$ユーフェミア$$.
When she infiltrated the $$ギアス嚮団$$, she was told of the plan of $$シャルル$$ and his associates by $$バトレー$$, who happened to be there, but was discovered by $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$ and detained. However, taking advantage of the confusion of the $$黒の騎士団$$'s raid on the Order, she escaped on her own and defeated the $$ジークフリート$$, piloted by $$Ｖ．Ｖ．$$, the source of $$ギアス$$.
Afterward she was held aboard the $$イカルガ$$, but joined $$シュナイゼル$$, who boarded the $$イカルガ$$ himself for direct negotiations with the $$黒の騎士団$$. From then on they acted together, but she saw through the true nature of $$シュナイゼル$$ and turned against him.
Later she attempted to assassinate $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$, who had defeated $$シュナイゼル$$, together with her former loyal retainer $$ギルフォード$$ and others, but ended up witnessing the conclusion of $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$.

proofread.reason: mistranslation: mistranslation: シャルルらの計画 = the plan of Charles and the others, not 'Charles's plan and more'

436.DSCR:
A former lieutenant colonel of the Japanese military, known by the epithet 'Miracle $$藤堂$$' for having commanded the Battle of $$厳島$$, Japan's only victory over $$ブリタニア$$. Age 38.
His single-minded fight for the liberation of Japan made him a pillar of spiritual support not only for his subordinates, the $$四聖剣$$, but for the $$黒の騎士団$$ as a whole.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, he was held by $$ブリタニア$$ for a little over a year, but was rescued by $$ゼロ$$ just before his execution and returned to the $$黒の騎士団$$.
In the $$超合集国$$ military he served as Chief of the Joint Staff.
Even when his subordinates such as $$朝比奈$$ and $$千葉$$ voiced distrust of $$ゼロ$$, he rated $$ゼロ$$'s talent highly and continued to trust $$ゼロ$$ as commander. In the end, however, he gave up on $$ゼロ$$, because the $$ギアス$$ had been involved in the deaths of his former comrades of the $$日本解放戦線$$, and because of $$朝比奈$$'s words at the moment of death.
In the final battle, he tried to sortie again despite being critically wounded, but was stopped by $$千葉$$, who had feelings for him. Having thus survived, $$藤堂$$ watched $$皇帝ルルーシュ$$ see $$ゼロ・レクイエム$$ through to completion, and afterward devoted himself to the reconstruction of Japan.

437.DSCR:
A former Japanese military officer who swore loyalty to $$藤堂$$, and one of the $$四聖剣$$. Age 30.
She had a spirited personality, but also showed a modest side, such as secretly having feelings for $$藤堂$$ and being unable to confess them.
After the $$ブラックリベリオン$$, she was held by $$ブリタニア$$ for a little over a year, but was rescued by $$ゼロ$$ just before her execution and returned to the $$黒の騎士団$$.
In the midst of the fighting, she made up her mind and confessed to $$藤堂$$, saying, 'There's something I want you to hear after the fighting is over.' She was put off that time, but before the final battle she seemed to have received some kind of answer.
In the $$超合集国$$ military she served as captain of the Fourth Squadron, and is the only one of the $$四聖剣$$ to have survived to the very end.

438.DSCR:
A boy who had been regarded as the reincarnation of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the 'Wings of the Sun.' Estimated age 13.
Orphaned in the great catastrophe eleven years earlier, he had lived on toughly as a street child, joining forces with $$バロン$$ and others in the same situation.
Besides a rare wild instinct, his astonishing eyesight (5.0 or better in both eyes) and outstanding sense of smell, able to tell apart not only body odor but even the scent of infrared rays, well suited the name of wild child.
His personality was straightforward for better or worse, and he was prone to actions that could even be called selfish. He seemed to lack even a shred of team spirit, but was so loyal to his friends that he would brave any danger for them. He boarded $$アクエリオン$$, too, in order to save $$バロン$$, who had been captured by the $$堕天翅$$.
For a while after entering $$エレメント$$ School, he caused frequent trouble through unfamiliar group life and solo play. But through the fighting he learned cooperation and teamwork, and along with that gradually recalled his past lives.
When the crisis of the world's end came after the final battle, he overcame all the friction and clashes up to then, completed the Genesis Union with $$シリウス$$ and $$頭翅#pilot$$, and became a human sacrifice to save the world. At that time he appeared before $$シルヴィア$$ as a spiritual body and gave her a parting kiss and a vow to meet again 12,000 years later.

proofread.reason: mistranslation (number, term): number: 両目共に５．０以上 is 5.0 or more, not 'better than'; mistranslation: 人柱 is a human sacrifice, 'human pillar' does not mean that in English

439.DSCR:
A first-squad $$エレメント$$ attending $$エレメント$$ School. Age 16.
Prince of the old $$アリシア#alisia$$ Kingdom and older brother of $$シルヴィア$$. He cherished a rose he had named $$アリシア#alisia$$, composed poems at every opportunity, and lavished affection on everything beautiful. He acknowledged $$麗花$$'s bearing as beautiful and held affection for her. But since he utterly rejected the opposite, the ugly and the barbaric, he clashed constantly with $$アポロ$$, a bundle of wildness. Much of that toward $$アポロ$$, however, also came from frustration at never being able to recall his own past life, and from jealousy of him.
His $$エレメント$$ ability emitted high-speed vibration from his right arm, and by transmitting it to a sword he could produce astonishing cutting power. His hearing also far surpassed that of ordinary people.
Together with his younger sister $$シルヴィア$$, he had on his right arm a wing of the $$天翅$$, deeply tied to his past life, and had always kept it hidden under a wristband. Later, when $$頭翅#pilot$$ invited him to $$アトランディア$$, $$麗花$$ reached out to stop him, but saw the wing and instinctively pulled her hand back. Stunned by that reaction, $$シリウス$$ realized he no longer had a place on the surface world, and fell to the $$天翅$$. But upon learning that $$頭翅#pilot$$, who had guided him, had been using him for $$頭翅#pilot$$'s own ends, he fought alongside $$アポロ$$ and the others again out of anger.
When the crisis of the world's end came after the final battle, he overcame all the friction and clashes up to then, completed the Genesis Union with $$アポロ$$ and $$頭翅#pilot$$, and became a human sacrifice to save the world.

proofread.reason: mistranslation (term): mistranslation: 人柱 is a human sacrifice ('human pillar' does not convey it); same wording as pilot 438

440.DSCR:
A first-squad $$エレメント$$ attending $$エレメント$$ School. Age 14.
Princess of the old $$アリシア#alisia$$ Kingdom, who carried on the bloodline of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ and $$セリアン$$. She had the ability to emit psychokinesis by focusing her energy in her left arm, letting her lift or bend any object.
Perhaps because she lost her parents when she was small, she felt an abnormal degree of love for her older brother, $$シリウス$$. She was therefore wary of every woman who approached $$シリウス$$, and felt hostility toward $$麗花$$ in particular. She had inherited the past life of $$セリアン$$ and was convinced that the reincarnation of her lover from that life, the 'Wings of the Sun,' was $$シリウス$$. But when she was confronted with the fact that $$アポロ$$, the wild child who suddenly appeared one day, might in fact be the 'Wings of the Sun,' she stubbornly refused to accept it. Helped along by the memories of her own past life, however, she gradually came to admit it.
Together with $$シリウス$$, she had on her left arm a wing of the $$堕天翅$$, deeply tied to her past life, and had always kept it hidden under a wristband. After $$シリウス$$ switched over to the side of the $$堕天翅$$, she too received an invitation from her brother. But moved by the words of $$アポロ$$, she resolved to live on as a human, and turned down the invitation of $$シリウス$$.
When the end of the world arrived after the final battle, she made the warring $$アポロ$$, $$シリウス$$, and $$頭翅#pilot$$ realize, through the memories of $$セリアン$$, the existence of a light born from the darkness.
She and $$アポロ$$, with whom she had connected hearts in her past life and in the present day as well, ended up separated, but she was convinced that he would surely come back to this planet someday.

441.DSCR:
Commander of the $$アクエリオン$$ operations unit of the special agency 'Earth Regeneration Organization $$ディーバ$$,' who also has a side as an instructor at $$エレメント$$ School. Age unknown.
Because he appears out of nowhere and turns up anywhere, he has the epithet 'Magician of Godspeed.' He has mastered a wide and deep range of skills, from magic-like tricks such as producing arrows from nowhere and suddenly enlarging a sheet of calligraphy paper, to astonishing abilities such as reading people's minds, summoning wild hawks with a single finger, and reading a person's character and tastes from their footprints alone.
Apart from having been a member of the $$アクエリオン$$ excavation survey team, nothing at all is known of his past career. He is an enigmatic figure, with even how he became commander unknown, yet his words are strangely persuasive. He always gives the $$エレメント$$s hints for getting through difficulties, leading them to victory.

442.DSCR:
A $$聖天翅$$ of the $$堕天翅$$ race, and a front-line commander who leads the $$天翅$$.
Although he has a wing at the back of his head, his appearance is otherwise the closest to human among the $$堕天翅$$.
Twelve thousand years ago, $$頭翅#pilot$$ was betrothed to $$アポロニアス#pilot$$, the strongest $$守護天翅$$. But since $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ betrayed the $$堕天翅$$ race at the end of the Great $$アトランディア$$ War, they crossed blades as enemies. Yet that love had not faded, and $$頭翅#pilot$$ repeatedly made contact with $$アポロ$$, who seemed to be the reincarnation of $$アポロニアス#pilot$$.
In the course of the fighting, $$頭翅#pilot$$ killed $$アポロ$$'s best friend, $$バロン$$, and seduced $$シリウス$$ with clever words into switching sides, using various means to torment $$アポロ$$ and the others. But when the $$生命の樹$$ withered and the world faced the crisis of its end, $$頭翅#pilot$$ even teleported to $$ベクタールナ$$ to try to stop it. Even so, $$アポロ$$ and $$シリウス$$ still were not in step with $$頭翅#pilot$$, but through the memories of $$セリアン$$ that $$シルヴィア$$ showed them, they learned that the $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ of old had not betrayed, but had wished for the coexistence of the $$天翅$$ and humans. Once they had firmly resolved to carry on that will, the three succeeded in the Genesis Union and held together the shattering world.
Note that '$$堕天翅$$' is a derogatory term the human side gave to the $$天翅$$, and they call themselves '$$天翅$$' (the $$堕天翅$$ side's derogatory term for humans is 'wingless' or 'wingless people').

443.DSCR:
The strongest $$守護天翅$$ of the $$天翅$$ race.
Twelve thousand years ago, he displayed his great power to hunt many humans and commit slaughter without limit. But in the midst of the fighting he met $$セリアン$$, a human woman warrior, and the two came to love each other.
In time he parted ways with the $$天翅$$ race and began fighting alongside humans, and used '$$機械天使アクエリオン$$' to sink $$アトランディア$$ into subspace.
In the final battle, it was revealed through the past life of $$セリアン$$ that his siding with humans during the Great $$アトランディア$$ War had been to seek a world in which humans and the $$堕天翅$$ coexist. His determination moved the hearts of $$アポロ$$, $$シリウス$$, and $$頭翅#pilot$$, leading them to resolve to become living sacrifices to save the world.

444.DSCR:
A brave human woman warrior who fought the $$堕天翅$$ race twelve thousand years ago.
She met $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ in the midst of the fighting, and they came to love each other even though they were enemies. Later they joined forces and defeated the $$堕天翅$$ race with '$$機械天使アクエリオン$$.'
In the present age, $$シルヴィア$$ holds the beautiful memories of light among the past lives of $$セリアン$$, so that personality occasionally appears, though only rarely. The terrible memories of darkness were passed on to $$シリウス$$.

445.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
He has the $$エレメント$$ ability 'Gravity Interference,' which lets him float into the air when emotionally excited. But he hates this power, since it caused others to shun him and led to his mother abandoning him, so he hid it away and worked as a live-in employee at a movie theater.
He loves the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$,' and fell in love at first sight with $$ミコノ$$ after seeing her moved to tears by it.
He is a somewhat faint-hearted boy who is easily flustered, but when it truly matters he has the inner strength to overcome his fear and fight.
He used his hidden power to save $$ミコノ$$ from an attack by the $$アブダクター$$, and that act also awakened $$アクエリオンＥＶＯＬ#robot$$. Taking this as his chance, he enrolled at $$聖天使学園$$ as an $$エレメント$$ cadet, and from then on found himself locked in an ongoing struggle against the $$アブダクター$$.
He is the reincarnation of $$アポロ$$, who fought the $$堕天翅$$ with the $$神話型アクエリオン$$ 12,000 years ago, and $$カグラ$$, who shares half of that same divided soul, repeatedly clashed with him over $$ミコノ$$.
But unlike $$カグラ$$, who saw $$ミコノ$$ only as the reincarnation of $$シルヴィア$$, $$アマタ$$ loved $$ミコノ$$ for who she was in the present, regardless of the past, and kept fighting to protect her.
When $$ミコノ$$ was captured by $$ミカゲ$$, who was consumed by hatred from the past, $$アマタ$$ fought the $$エンシェントＡＱ$$ alongside his comrades. Facing its overwhelming power, he was on the verge of defeat, but driven by his single desire to save $$ミコノ$$, he charged in alone aboard $$ベクターゼド$$. His powerful feelings won out, and he succeeded in rescuing $$ミコノ$$. He and $$ミコノ$$ combined into $$アクエリオンＬＯＶＥ$$, putting an end to a myth 24,000 years in the making.

446.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
An energetic girl, bold even with the opposite sex, who likes to wear revealing clothes.
She boasts the highest combat ability among the female cadets and often gets to pilot $$アクエリオン$$. She excels at hand-to-hand combat and is someone the team can rely on in battle, though she also has a girlish side, such as being afraid of ghosts.
Her $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Impact Force,' which lets her amplify a small amount of force into a much greater one.
She often teased $$アマタ$$ and $$ミコノ$$, both hopelessly shy, about their relationship, but gradually began to see $$アマタ$$ as more than a friend herself.
Unable to break into the one-sided devotion $$アマタ$$ held for $$ミコノ$$, she came to despise herself for never being able to make a move. Out of that frustration, she awakened a new $$エレメント$$ ability, 'Twisting Force,' which lets her twist and deform objects.
During a mock battle involving $$アクエリオンゲパルト$$, she confessed her feelings on impulse, and the resulting rush of emotion sent $$アクエリオン$$ out of control.
Afterward she continued to suffer from the pain of $$アマタ$$ never returning her feelings, and eventually $$ミカゲ$$ exploited that opening in her heart and took over her body.
However, after breaking free of $$ミカゲ$$'s control together with $$カグラ$$, she let go of everything and lent her support to $$アマタ$$ as he fought to save $$ミコノ$$.

447.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
The de facto leader among the $$エレメント$$ cadets, a man known as the 'Eternal Number Two.'
A former marine, he comes from a military family that has produced $$エレメント$$-abled soldiers for generations. His good build, wild manner, and strictness toward himself and others alike make him dependable, and he is popular with the girls.
He is also $$ミコノ$$'s older brother by blood. He is hard on her, but in truth he worries about her and only pushes her away from the fighting out of concern for her safety. Because of this, he has no great fondness for $$アマタ$$, who was the reason $$ミコノ$$ became an $$エレメント$$ cadet in the first place.
His $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Despair Precognition.' It manifests regardless of his own will, letting him foresee misfortunes that will befall him.
Because of $$シュレード$$'s presence, he is derided as the 'Eternal Number Two,' but since $$シュレード$$ is often unable to sortie, $$カイエン$$ is effectively $$ネオディーヴァ$$'s main fighting strength. He is uncomfortable with being called 'best friend' by $$シュレード$$, but deep down he feels just as strong a bond with him.
At the final battle, he boarded the $$ベクターシロン$$ carrying $$シュレード$$'s feelings within it, and brought forth a new configuration, $$アクエリオンゲパーダ$$.

448.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
She met $$アマタ$$ at the movie theater where she went to see the film '$$アクエリアの舞う空$$.'
She is normally cheerful and gentle, but having grown up constantly compared to her excellent older brother $$カイエン$$ by their parents, she has trouble feeling confident in herself.
She is a hard worker, but clumsy and unable to take that last decisive step. Because her personality is so similar to $$アマタ$$'s, the two sometimes call each other 'fellow no-hopers.'
She has no special $$エレメント$$ ability of her own, and that had long been a source of insecurity for her. In truth, though, her ability was a special one that no instrument could measure -- 'the Power to Connect,' a type of ability that let her share and amplify the abilities and senses of other $$エレメント$$s.
She is the reincarnation of $$シルヴィア$$ from 12,000 years ago, and found herself caught between the feelings of $$アマタ$$ and $$カグラ$$, both reincarnations of $$アポロ$$, tormented by memories reaching back into the past.
While held captive within $$ミカゲ$$'s labyrinth of the heart, she learned the depth of $$ミカゲ$$'s feelings for $$アポロニアス#pilot$$ and tried to accept his sorrow, but was rejected by him.
Together with $$アマタ$$, who charged in alone to save her from $$ミカゲ$$'s grasp, their love completed $$アクエリオンＬＯＶＥ$$ and saved the world.

449.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
An optimist and $$ネオディーヴァ$$'s mood-maker. He became an $$エレメント$$ cadet in hopes of one day combining with his destined woman, and is aggressive about making an impression on girls.
He has the ability 'Digging Force,' which lets him find the weak points in a material's bonds and break through them to dig holes.
In search of that destined woman, he keeps relentlessly digging in an attempt to cross the 'Berlin Wall' separating the boys' and girls' sections of $$聖天使学園$$. His obsession runs deep, and he even formed the 'Digging Brothers' with the newly transferred $$アマタ$$ to share the joys of digging with him.
He was on terrible terms with $$ＭＩＸ$$, who is a germaphobe, hates men, and despises the very existence of holes, but as they complemented each other's abilities through battle, they gradually became important to one another.
When $$ＭＩＸ$$ was captured by $$アルテア$$ and her body was turned male, he struggled to come to terms with it. But he resolved to accept her (him?) regardless of gender, confessed his feelings, and succeeded in rescuing her safely.

450.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
A beautiful boy who is a genius pianist and, with combat ability to match, boasts skill among the very best of the $$エレメント$$ cadets.
However, he is sickly, and each time he resonates with $$アクエリオン$$ his life is shortened, so he can rarely take part in actual combat.
He likens every battle to a piece of music, treating the fight itself as a single composition, and his goal is to complete the ultimate melody, even at the cost of his own life.
His $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Mental Performance,' which lets him play music to confuse the hearts of others. This ability was exploited in his childhood, but he was scouted by $$クレア$$ and became an $$エレメント$$ cadet.
He one-sidedly calls $$カイエン$$ his 'best friend,' and for that reason is treated as a nuisance by him. Deep down, however, $$カイエン$$ too feels a strong bond with $$シュレード$$.
As the fighting intensified, his sorties increased and his body was steadily worn away. He used up the last of his strength to help $$アマタ$$ and $$ゼシカ$$ cross the dimensional barrier, and vanished beyond the dimensional horizon along with his $$ベクターマシン$$. Yet at the very brink of death, his ultimate melody was completed, and at the final battle, $$カイエン$$, riding the $$ベクターシロン$$ infused with the melody of his soul, brought forth a new configuration, $$アクエリオンゲパーダ$$.

451.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
In contrast to his ethnic-styled looks, he is serious and level-headed, and among a roster of highly individualistic cadets he serves as both peacemaker and voice of reason.
He is well trusted, to the point that classmates say, 'If $$モロイ$$ says so, it must be right!'
His $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Fragility Force,' which breaks down the molecular bonds of any material, making it easy to shatter with even a slight impact. Combined with a physical attack, this lets him deal a great deal of damage.
In a mock battle, he combined his ability with $$サザンカ$$'s 'Corrosion Force' to drive $$アマタ$$ and the others into a corner.
At the final battle, claiming that being born in the tropics made him tough against the heat, he sortied undaunted by the black sun $$ミカゲ$$ had summoned.

452.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
An excellent student and a caring student-council-president type of girl.
She has an outstanding figure that $$アンディ$$ has dubbed the 'Big Bang.'
A perfectionist and germaphobe, she is strict with herself and others, and tolerates neither breaches of discipline nor romance between students.
In the past, her father vanished with a younger woman to a secluded hot spring, and growing up watching her mother's struggles left her with a trauma that made her hate men and holes alike.
Her $$エレメント$$ ability is 'Spatial Compensation,' which lets her seal off space at the molecular level without leaving the slightest gap.
She has clashed with $$アンディ$$, whose ability 'Digging Force' is her exact opposite, time and again, their $$エレメント$$ abilities colliding head-on.
On learning that $$アルテア$$'s aim was to abduct women with $$エレメント$$ abilities, she let herself be captured in order to save $$ゼシカ$$, who, driven to despair by heartbreak, was about to surrender herself.
Afterward, under the influence of the 'Curse of Eve,' her body was turned male. With her memories manipulated, she was made to fight $$ネオディーヴァ$$ as a boy soldier.
In the end, $$アンディ$$'s desperate persuasion brought her memories back, and she accepted his love. Having returned to $$ヴェーガ$$, her body seems to be gradually reverting as well.

453.DSCR:
An $$エレメント$$ cadet at $$ネオディーヴァ$$.
Extremely shy and awkward around strangers.
She always carries around $$タマ$$, a stuffed toy that may or may not be a cat.
When she first transferred in, she could not fit in with her class, and her wish to simply disappear triggered her $$エレメント$$ ability, 'Optical Transparency.' This ability lets her turn objects, herself included, invisible, and when piloting $$アクエリオン$$ it renders the entire unit invisible, letting laser weapons pass right through it.
Because this power made her vanish whenever she appeared in front of others, and her body stayed invisible for long stretches of time, she became the subject of a ghost story known as 'the Vanishing $$エレメント$$.'
However, meeting the other cadets slowly began to bring her out of her shell.
When $$ジン$$ infiltrated $$ネオディーヴァ$$ disguised as a transfer student, she worried about him and looked out for him, since he made no effort to fit in with the other cadets. When $$ジン$$ tried to steal a $$ベクターマシン$$, she talked him out of it, and the two of them came to understand each other, only for $$ミカゲ$$ to take $$ジン$$'s life shortly after.
She sank into grief for a time, but returned to duty after hearing $$ジン$$'s voice during the grueling 'grave-pit' training. Overcoming the sorrow of losing someone precious to her, she grew both gentler and stronger.

pilot 403: the Tengoku Japanese drops the age and the word 時折 (occasionally) from the grave-visit sentence, so it is retranslated as a past event ('When he visited the grave... he had Shinji come along').
pilot 410: Jigoku said Shinji 'saves them both'; the Japanese only says Kensuke was helped (シンジに助けられ), so I wrote 'saves him'.

pilot 416: Jigoku's 'as a child' after 'the young Tianzi' was dropped (the Japanese 幼き天子 says the Tianzi was young, not that Xingke was a child). Gao Hai, Tianzi, Chinese Federation etc. are tokenized as new names although Jigoku left them literal.

pilot 419-437: no Jigoku text; Code Geass names taken from memory of the official English release, since the akurasu Z3.2 files only cover Zero, Suzaku, Kallen and C.C. from Code Geass. Please verify Tohdoh, Croomy, Cardemonde and Invogue in particular.
pilot 419: 伯爵 written as 'earl' (Britannian nobility); 主任 written as 'chief'. 特別派遣嚮導技術部 is a literal rendering, official English unknown.
pilot 424: 内務掃拭賛助官 is rendered literally as 'Internal Affairs Cleanup Assistant Officer'; the official English of this made-up title is unknown to me.

pilot 433: 一時的にコードを封印していたＣ．Ｃ． is read as a relative clause on C.C. ('who had temporarily sealed away her Code'); the alternative reading is that Marianne temporarily controlled Anya. Also the subject of 屋敷 (whose estate Anya served in) is left unspecified as 'the estate'.
pilot 432: その全てを否定され is kept ambiguous ('all of it was denied by Lelouch') because the Japanese does not say whether it is the plan or everything about him.

pilot 438-444: 創聖合体 is rendered 'Genesis Union' (my guess at the official term; not tokenized). 天翅/聖天翅/守護天翅 are new tokens whose English (Celestial Wing / Holy Wing / Guardian Wing) I derived from the proposed 堕天翅 = Fallen Wing. 頭翅 is proposed as 'Head Wing' following the glossary keyword; I could not confirm an official romanization, and I avoided pronouns for this character because the Japanese does not settle gender.

pilot 439/440: the glossary token アリシア gives 'Alicia' (a pilot entry), but the akurasu wiki spells the kingdom name 'Alisia' (Sirius/Silvia de Alisia). I kept the token for both the kingdom and the rose, so the prose will read 'Alicia Kingdom' while the character names read 'de Alisia'; please settle. Wiki wins.
pilot 439: 天翅 (Sirius, 'a wing of the Celestial Wing') vs 堕天翅 (Silvia, 'a wing of the Fallen Wing') are as in the Japanese, which differs between the siblings.
pilot 441: Gen Fudou is written with he/him as a known character (the Japanese has no pronoun). Fudo Gen's epithet 神速の魔術師 is rendered 'Magician of Godspeed'.

pilot 445/448: Jigoku's アポロン is now アポロ in the Tengoku Japanese, so $$アポロ$$ replaces the Jigoku 'Apollon'; Jigoku 'Sylvia' became $$シルヴィア$$ (Silvia per wiki). In 445 I changed Jigoku's 'Together they combined into Aquarion LOVE' to 'He combined into Aquarion LOVE' because the Japanese does not name Mikono as a subject there.
pilot 450: the Jigoku DSC2 sentence 'though he believes the feeling is one-sided; in truth...' was replaced by a fresh translation of the changed Japanese (一方的に... それ故に彼に煙たがられている).
pilot 453: 墓穴特訓 was rendered 'grave-pit' training (Jigoku had 'grueling training undertaken in his memory', which dropped 墓穴). Please check the Jigoku sentence against the game context.
